source.publication: 2025 Schedule M1M Income Additions and Subtractions
source.section: Form M1 lines 1-4, 7-10 (instructions PDF p.13 Standard Deduction Table for Line 4, p.14 Worksheet A, p.39 Tax Rate Schedules, pp.32-38 tax table); Schedule M1M line 17 (M1M PDF p.5 'Line 17 - Railroad Retirement Board Benefits')

worked: Each spouse's railroad annuity (Form 1040 line 5b) is subtracted in full. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 50,000.00 + pension 30,000.00 = 80,000.00. Federal taxable income = 80,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction (31,500 plus 0 x 1,600) = 48,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form M1, married filing jointly: line 1 federal AGI 80,000.00. Schedule M1M line 1 other-state municipal interest 0.00; line 10 additions 0.00; Form M1 line 2 0.00; line 3 = 80,000.00. Schedule M1M line 16: no one is 65 or older (born before January 2, 1961), so no Schedule M1R subtraction. Schedule M1M line 17 Railroad Retirement Board benefits 30,000.00, included in federal AGI on Form 1040 line 5b. Schedule M1M line 40 = Form M1 line 7 subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 + 30,000.00 + 0.00 = 30,000.00 (lines 12, 16, 17, 25). State income before deduction = 80,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 50,000.00. Standard Deduction Table for Line 4 (PDF p.13): base 29,900.00; AGI is not over 238,950.00, so no Worksheet A. Line 4 = 29,900.00. Form M1 line 8 total = 29,900.00 + 30,000.00 = 59,900.00; line 9 Minnesota taxable income = 80,000.00 - 59,900.00 = 20,100.00. Line 10 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.39): 5.35% x (20,100.00 - 0.00) = 1,075.35 = 1,075.35. The tax table (PDF pp.32-38) gives 1,078; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 16 credits 0.00 (the joint-filer Schedule M1C credit is not in the sources and is not applied); state income tax 1,075.35.
accepted_approximations: Tax comes from the rate schedules at every income; below 86,800 of taxable income the booklet requires its 100-wide tax table.
The Schedule M1C credit for joint filers is not applied because its amount is not in the sources.
